title: minuartia rubra subsp. rostrata
intro: Minuartia rubra subsp. rostrata, commonly known as Alpine Rock Jasmine or Red Sandwort, is a plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. It is a flowering plant that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Rock Jasmine include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which have been attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds may contribute to the plant's potential in treating various health conditions, including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and infections.
